source: User-pasted H200 CUPTI table and subsequent compiled_resources/comparison/paired_comparisons output
scope: GPU kernel durations, native resource counts, full/core API ratios, same-payload output check and paired trial summaries. Absolute API medians and detailed validation cases were not supplied.
table_columns: attention, all kernels and all GPU work are equal for each reported row

register_budget_estimate.limitation: Register-budget calculation only, not achieved occupancy/utilization or a measurement proving causality. Other launch/allocation limits can reduce residency.

decision: Do not promote paired QK. Retain scale-prefetch. Paired QK lost all 9 full API and all 9 fixed-core comparisons, with unchanged output.
interpretation: Remote counts confirm greater register/shared footprint and zero local storage. Register-budget residency drops from at most 3 to at most 2 blocks per SM. This supports resource pressure as a cause worth prioritizing, but does not establish its fraction of the slowdown. Preprocessing is excluded in the fixed-core regression. These are repeated descriptive observations, not a formal significance test or a model-quality/end-to-end inference benchmark.
